title: Shared flight model: space, atmosphere, VTOL (deterministic)
description: Implement the deterministic ship physics in src/shared, used verbatim by the server sim (authority) and the client prediction (TASK-14): Newtonian-ish space flight, simplified atmospheric drag, and VTOL landing control.
acceptanceCriteria: src/shared/physics/flight.ts exports integrateShip(state, input, dt, regime, planet?, shipClass): ShipState — pure function, no Math.random, no side effects; ShipState = {pos: Vec3, vel: Vec3, quat: Quat, regime, onPad?: string}

Space regime: thrust along ship axes scaled by input, no drag, optional tiny damping (0.0), rotation at turnRate capped by class stats, speed clamped to maxVelocity (soft: extra thrust above max decays)

Atmosphere regime: quadratic drag (k * v² opposing velocity, k from planet.atmosphereDensity * area(mass)), vertical lift term for VTOL (input.up produces vertical acceleration independent of heading below VTOL speed), ground collision at terrain height (pos.y = terrainY, vel.y = 0, no tunneling: substep integration when |vel|*dt > 2m)
VTOL: within pad radius with vertical speed < threshold and on ground → state.onPad set (used by TASK-29/31)
Determinism test: same (state, input, dt) → identical state; fixed-dt integration over 60 s in space produces the golden trajectory fixture
Boundary continuity (shared with TASK-28): crossing the atmosphere boundary with constant input changes drag continuously (drag coefficient ramps 0→k over 1 km of boundary, not a step)
Unit tests: straight-line space trajectory, terminal velocity in atmosphere, VTOL hover convergence, ground collision, soft speed cap, unknown-regime throw

steps.details: src/shared/physics/vec.ts: Vec3 ops (add, scale, dot, cross, normalize, lerp), Quat (fromEuler, multiply, toMat3, rotateVector). Plain objects + functions, no dependencies.

integrateShip space branch: angular velocity from input (yaw/pitch/roll) at turnRate; thrust = forward*input.thrust*accel; vel += (thrust/mass)*dt; soft cap: if |vel| > maxVel, scale excess by 0.95 per step; pos += vel*dt; quat *= dRotation.

drag = -k*|v|*v with k = planet.atmoDensity * (mass/area); ramp k across the 1 km boundary (TASK-28 shares the same boundary function from a common module). VTOL: if input.up and |vel_horizontal| < 5 u/s, vel.y += vtolThrust*dt; ground: terrainY from a heightAt(x,z) callback injected by the caller (server: from surface gen; tests: analytic), clamp with substepping.
Record a 60 s space flight (constant inputs) + a 30 s atmo descent to a pad into fixtures; tests re-run integration and deep-compare with tolerance 1e-9 (determinism) and 0.01 u (rounding).
All listed unit tests; run npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test.

technicalNotes: The heightAt callback keeps this module planet-agnostic; the server injects the real chunk-based height lookup, tests inject analytic terrain.
Fixed dt on the server (1/20 s). The client may call with variable dt for prediction but must use the same function — document this in the module header.
Sim units: 1 u ≈ 1 m; velocities in u/s. Keep everything in these units end-to-end.
